instructions.instruction: Carry the clean plate with the left hand, remove the dirty plate with the right hand at table one, place the clean plate, and return the dirty plate with its contents to the return counter. Grip plate rims horizontally.
instructions.instruction_zh: 一手把干净餐盘拿到一号桌，另一手端走有纸巾和食物残留的旧盘，换上干净盘，再把旧盘送到回收台
